assumptions: Single-agent fallback was used as requested; each supported portal was checked separately without spawning sub-agents.
Only rows with a verifiable sale price and parcel area were retained.
Chalupa listings were normalized to property_type 'house'; chata listings were excluded.
gaps: No credible mmreality.cz row survived filtering: the active Nový Hrádek detail page found there was a louka, while other Nový Hrádek house/chalupa/building-land references were sold, inactive, or not available as an authoritative active detail URL in this run.
reality.aktualne.cz exposed Nový Hrádek search-result snippets, but I could not obtain stable detail-page URLs with enough fields for retention in this run.
Some cross-portal snapshot prices drifted for the same property; deduplication kept the lowest verified visible price only when at least one retained row had a usable detail URL.
